meta.title: Buka Workflows
meta.description: Persistent workflows with a job board: a workflow is a position graph, a job is one workflow plus one input, and every job gets a board. Tasks are added by running positions at any time, can only be dispatched along drawn channels, become ready through explicit dependencies, and are claimed by workers or people; a named assistant worker can handle a human task on the person's behalf. Structure constrains risk, the board carries throughput, and the built-in start / end tasks carry the raw input in and the final deliverable back to the starter.
